_source: Addresses: NERIS (neris.fsri.org FD36119816) and ryebrookny.gov; coordinates: NYS Geocoder, 2026-10-01
_egress: egress (ingress: the same unless given): the bay-door apron {lat, lon} and the street the rigs pull out onto; routes start and end there (sizeup/cad/routes.py). Without it: the firehouse's point and its address's street. ingress via "lot": back in through a lot, joining its drive aisles (service roads) rather than a street. South End: the apron on the building's west face; Rye Brook: out the north-east face onto King St, back in through the rear (the Village Hall / PD lot, from King St) at the south-west face; OpenStreetMap 2026-11-12
